name: Tuni Textile Mills Limited
summary: Tuni Textile Mills Ltd. specializes in the production of grey fabrics, offering a diverse range that includes polyester, cotton, polyester-cotton, polyester-viscose, and cotton-linen blends. The enterprise was established on July 6, 1987, by Narendra Kumar P. Sureka and Pradeep Kumar P. Sureka, with its primary operations based in Mumbai, India.
